title: Lesson Management
changes: Rename lessons and edit their notes
Renumber a lesson — numbers stay unique, so you can't collide with an existing lesson
Delete a lesson, choosing whether to keep its cards in your deck or delete them too
A card can now belong to more than one lesson at the same time
"Manage lessons" on any card lets you pick every lesson it belongs to
Add existing deck cards to a lesson from the lesson page
Remove a card from a lesson without deleting the card
Card badges now show when a card is shared across multiple lessons
